reason: The historical replay identified systematic 2023 oat underprediction, while earlier diagnostics showed a strong response to the unresolved fate of fresh 2022 wheat straw.
implementation: Two explicit APSIMX scenario artifacts are evaluated without modifying the calibrated base model.
Observed N30 and N60 labels are replayed identically in both scenarios.
Only Field2 and Field7 may differ; the evaluator fails if another field changes.
Outputs include scenario metrics and a per-field min-max envelope.
The envelope is labelled as a management-scenario range rather than a confidence interval.
unconfirmed_input: Whether fresh wheat straw from the 2022 harvest was retained or exported on Field2 and Field7.
